title: Superhuman Battlefield
description: Seventeen years ago, the world was saved from destruction by the Seven Heroes, but the strongest among them, Seomun Yeop, sacrificed himself. In the peaceful world that followed, superhumans known as espers turned their abilities toward Battle Field, a virtual reality game created to let them compete. When Korea's performance begins to decline, the legendary Seomun Yeop mysteriously returns. The greatest esper in history must now adapt to a changed world and once again fight to save his people.
author: Niccolo / Two Zero
